# Grigorii Moskalev — Legal counsel and legal engineer

> Grigorii Moskalev is a legal counsel who builds AI tools for legal teams. 11 years practicing law, 3 years writing Python. Author of PII Shield (open-source MCP server that anonymizes documents before LLM analysis) and Brand monitor (trademark-infringement scanner). Based in Limassol, Cyprus.

## Pages

- [Home / About](https://gmoskalev.com/): Profile, about, projects, writing, contact.
- [PII Shield](https://gmoskalev.com/pii-shield): Product page — open-source MCP server for Claude Desktop that anonymizes documents locally before they reach the API. Covers pipeline, six skill modes, what it detects, install, compliance, MCP tools, stack.
- [memoforge](https://gmoskalev.com/legal-memo-writer): Product page — Cowork plugin that turns a research-grade legal question into a footnoted .docx memorandum. Covers the multi-agent pipeline, Brief/Full modes, the 15 specialists, the output bundle, Style Studio, install, and limits.
- [Writing](https://gmoskalev.com/writing): Notes on legal-AI work — memos as web pages, PII Shield, AI agents for legal research, formatting skills, brand monitoring. Originally posted on LinkedIn.

## Projects

- [PII Shield (GitHub)](https://github.com/gregmos/PII-Shield): Node.js MCP server v2.0.2. Anonymizes PDF, DOCX, TXT files locally with GLiNER NER + 17 jurisdiction-specific pattern recognizers (UK, DE, FR, IT, ES, CY, EU). AES-GCM session export, multi-document session pooling, HITL review. MIT-licensed.
- [memoforge (GitHub)](https://github.com/gregmos/memoforge): Cowork plugin, v1.1.1. Turns a legal question into a footnoted .docx memo via a 15-agent pipeline — intake, parallel statutory/case-law/doctrinal research, currency check, IRAC drafting, five-reviewer peer review, mediation, up to three revision rounds, and client-readiness polish. Brief and Full modes; bundles Legal Data Hunter + CourtListener MCP servers; optional Style Studio house-style profiles. MIT-licensed.
- [Brand monitor (GitHub)](https://github.com/gregmos/Brand-monitor): Skill that scans App Store and the open web for trademark infringers and pirated APKs. Runs weekly. Single SKILL.md file — works on Claude or OpenClaw.
- [PII Shield v1.0.0 release](https://github.com/gregmos/PII-Shield/releases/tag/v1.0.0): Python + Presidio + spaCy original. Replaced by v2 Node.js rewrite. Kept downloadable for legacy installs.
